About Us
Ezulwini Game Lodge is set in the very heart of Zululand, famous for its wildlife, wetlands and Zulu culture.
Ezulwini Game Lodge offers comfortable accommodation for both small and large tour groups and is ideally suited for corporate getaways, with a fully equipped conference venue. With guaranteed wildlife sightings, warm hospitality, delicious food, and affordable rates, we ensure a truly memorable African bush holiday.
The main attractions in the area include False Bay Park, the national game reserves Hluhluwe-iMfolozi and Mkuze Game Reserve — and the iSimangaliso Wetland Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Two unspoilt beaches, Sodwana Bay and Cape Vidal, are just an hour’s drive away.
It has long been a favourite destination for hikers — whether you're staying in a Lodge Room, Chalet, Log Cabin, or Family House.

Activities
We would gladly share our local knowledge with you, enabling you to make the most of your time spent
in our amazing region.
We can assist by advising on the best possible itinerary.
Safaris
The area offers incredible biodiversity, with over 340 bird species and 1,250 fish species in the marine reserves. It’s all about the wildlife, wetlands, and Zulu culture.
Safaris to explore the wildlife are available in elevated game drive vehicles, by boat cruise etc.
Hiking
Hiking in Hluhluwe's False Bay area offers a variety of trails, including those within False Bay Park, a part of the iSimangaliso Wetland Park. False Bay Park features both easy, flat trails and more challenging, scenic routes. The area is known for its diverse wildlife and is a popular destination for both mountain biking and hiking.
